value.rationale: Higgins isolated the O_n permutation-matching problem, and the involution variant is a strictly stronger natural graph-theoretic property. A complete explicit finite certificate to n=10 (92378 maps at the largest n) is a mathematically motivated large cutoff and supplies exact witnesses where general permutation theory is insufficient; no paper-sized universal theorem is required.

final_claim: For each 1<=n<=10 the monoid O_n of order-preserving full maps of [n] has an involution matching by mutual semigroup inverses. A complete 62,704 two-cycle certificate pairs all nonfixed maps and leaves only idempotent fixed points; no assertion for n>=11.
limitations: Only n<=10; no general n theorem or canonical construction.
Verifies finite certificate exactly, not originality beyond best-of-knowledge.
